scope.proposed_concept: weighted_average_shares_basic (new; distinct from shares_outstanding point-in-time and from diluted)
exclusions: is_derived=true facts (see counterexamples: Q4 subtraction produces negatives)
BasicAndDiluted combined tags as plain basic

candidates.relationship: combined (basic = diluted, issuer reports one line)
candidates.precedence: plain-basic fallback ONLY under a reviewer-approved combined rule; otherwise keep as separate combined line

coexistence.Basic vs BasicAndDiluted: 576 contexts, 62 issuers, 489 equal, 87 unequal (scale mismatch cases)
coexistence.Basic + DilutionAdjustment = Diluted: 1,419 contexts, 38 issuers, 1,339 exact (94%) - supports component class
coexistence.issuer_counts: basic 138, basicAndDiluted 70, both 68, BD-without-basic 2, neither basic nor BD 9 of 150

counterexamples.case: DERIVED NEGATIVES: 921 of 1,019 is_derived basic facts are negative (90%), 914 are Q4; 129 of 138 issuers affected, e.g. company 2052 FY2022-2025 -197M..-230M against a ~101M median. Derived Q4 = FY - 9M-YTD subtraction is invalid for weighted averages (03 rule: no generic subtraction of weighted-average shares).
company 1143 2018-03-31: Basic 2,037,000 vs BasicAndDiluted 2,037 - a 1000x unit/scale mismatch between two tags of the same issuer-period (87 unequal contexts of 576)

non-derived values stored under the tag are EPS-sized: company 5820 2010-07-01..09-30 -0.06, -0.2 (unit 'shares'); company 2301 2012 -1.97, -6.96 under BasicAndDiluted tag - issuer mis-tagging, quarantine rather than map
company 2260 2024-12-31 Q4: Basic -282,915,000 vs WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesIssuedBasic 1,157,000

decisions.rationale: Basic weighted-average shares is a reported-only figure (never derivable by subtraction). The primary tag covers 138/150 sample issuers. 9/150 report neither basic nor combined and 70 report the combined tag in addition to or instead of basic: combined lines are not mapped as plain basic. The mapper must exclude is_derived=true facts for this concept because the Normalizer's Q4 derivation emits negative values for 90% of derived rows.
alternatives_considered: Include derived Q4 values: rejected on evidence (921 negatives).
Take BasicAndDiluted as basic when basic absent: pending reviewer; sample shows 2 issuers that have BD without basic.
decisions.proposed_relationship_class: exact (WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOutstandingBasic); combined (BasicAndDiluted variants); component (DilutionAdjustment); not_equivalent (IssuedBasic, ProForma)

proposed_mapping.positive_conditions: duration, unit shares, is_derived=false, is_authoritative=true, value>0
proposed_mapping.negative_conditions: exclude derived; exclude EPS-magnitude values; no subtraction ever

decisions.conflict_note: primary tag: 589 auth-less contexts of 9110, 392 with spread >15% (largest conflict rate of the 10 families).

impact.engineering_flag: Existing core.fact derived weighted-average Q4 rows (in this sample: 1,019 basic, 955 diluted, 182 basic-and-diluted) include negatives; separate defect for Period Engineer / Data Engineer, not fixed here

evidence.locator: is_derived=true AND value<0 for tag WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOutstandingBasic: 921 rows

decisions.next_action: Hand derived-negative finding to Period Engineer (and Triage); Standardization Lead to rule on combined fallback; Verifier to read EPS notes for 2052, 1143, 5820.
decisions.next_reviewer: Period Engineer (derived defect), Standardization Lead, then Data Verifier

coexistence.InterestPaid vs InterestPaidNet: 298 contexts, 56 issuers, 248 equal, 50 unequal; 63 issuers file both tags in different periods (e.g. company 103: InterestPaid FY2008-2014, Net 2019-2026; 607: 2008-2025 vs 2018-2026)
coexistence.InterestPaid vs InterestExpense: 1,208 contexts, 111 equal; 166 of 1,145 with ratio outside 1/3-3x

counterexamples.case: cash vs expense: company 103 2008-2009: InterestPaid 1.225M vs InterestExpense 4.353M; 2020-10-03..2021-07-02 InterestPaidNet 0 vs InterestExpense 2.6M - cash paid is not interest expense, never substitute
company 1800 2025: InterestPaid 4,629 vs InterestPaidNet 5,870 (H1) - the two cash tags differ in same period (net-of-capitalized or restatement basis)
company 604 2013: InterestPaid 11.999M vs InterestPaidCapitalized 0.443M - capitalized portion is a memo item, not a replacement
52 negative InterestPaidNet facts (and many is_derived=true YTD-subtracted quarter rows: 1,816 derived of 4,834) - cash-flow YTD subtraction is allowed for additive flows, but negatives need review

decisions.rationale: Two same-concept tags used in different eras by the same issuers (InterestPaid then InterestPaidNet); 63 issuers file both in different periods, and where both exist in the same context 83% are equal. Treat as one concept with era-based precedence, but verify the capitalized-interest difference. Note not all issuers disclose (supplemental, often a note); 'no tag' != zero.
alternatives_considered: Map to interest_expense: rejected (cash vs accrual).
Use InterestPaid as always-higher precedence: rejected, the newer tag is the dominant current one.
decisions.proposed_relationship_class: exact (InterestPaidNet and InterestPaid, with explicit net-of-capitalized caveat); component (Capitalized); not_equivalent (InterestExpense, Discontinued)

scope.existing: shares_outstanding (id 16/350) is already approved on us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding and dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding - NOT changed; outstanding stays distinct from issued and authorized

coexistence.issuer_counts: issued 127, outstanding 128, authorized 128; issued-without-outstanding 4, outstanding-without-issued 5, authorized-without-issued 7

counterexamples.case: company 103 2009-10-02: Issued 177.9M vs Outstanding 172.8M vs Authorized 525M - three different, valid quantities; equality only when no treasury stock
company 5773 2024-09-30: Issued 2.660B < Outstanding 2.960B (7 of 4,017 contexts have issued<outstanding) - likely multi-class or data conflict
company 1851 2021-06-30: Issued 370.1M > Authorized 150M (1 of 4,267 contexts) - impossible on one class; multi-class or error
company 1051 2023-07-31: Outstanding 8.503M vs dei EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding 4.929M - balance-sheet and cover-page counts differ in date and may differ in class scope

multi-class issuers: Company Facts exposes no class dimension; only 1 context had more than one distinct authoritative value for issued/outstanding, i.e. class detail is likely collapsed or lost upstream - dual-class share totals cannot be assumed

decisions.rationale: Issued, outstanding and authorized are three distinct balance-sheet quantities (issued>=outstanding by treasury stock; authorized is a legal cap). Keep four new concepts separate and leave shares_outstanding alone. Never infer outstanding = issued, or issued from authorized. Preferred counts are mostly reported zeros (2,653 of 3,128 issued) - preserve reported zero, do not interpret as no authorization.
alternatives_considered: Single 'shares' concept with a kind field: rejected (hides issued vs outstanding distinction).
Use dei cover-page count as outstanding fallback: already existing policy (approved), untouched.
decisions.proposed_relationship_class: exact for each tag-to-own-concept; not_equivalent across the three kinds
decisions.conflict_note: Issued: 166 auth-less of 4652 (101 >15%); Outstanding: 211 of 4524 (106 >15%); Authorized: 104 of 4810 (99 >15%).

evidence.locator: CommonStockSharesIssued active=4405, Authorized active=4337, Outstanding approved
